$comment: TRANSCRIBED FROM THE ORCHESTRATOR SPEC — not from src/orchestrator/index.ts.
This is the wire contract the SDK's WORKFLOW_STEP_TYPES / IMAGE_GEN_ENGINES
catalogs claim to mirror, kept in its own file so TWO independent checks can
1. test/orchestrator.test.ts pins the SDK catalogs to these lists (hermetic,
2. scripts/check-orchestrator-catalogs.mjs re-fetches the LIVE spec and pins
THESE LISTS to it (network, runs in CI as `pnpm check:catalogs`).
Together those two make the SDK catalogs equal the live spec. Neither alone
does: (1) cannot see the orchestrator shipping a new step, and (2) cannot see
the SDK catalog falling behind this file.
workflowStepTypes = the key set of components.schemas.WorkflowStepTemplate
